notes: Matched 2AFC product pairs for the second product category (coffee machines). Same design as headphones: base_price, rating, and rating_count are identical within a pair; descriptions are neutral (category + specs only, no price/rating/persuasion) and length-matched; specs are identical within a pair. Cues are applied at runtime, not baked in. Base prices span a range distinct from headphones so cue premia can be examined against a different absolute price level.

product_a.name: BrewLine DC-12
product_a.neutral_description: Programmable drip coffee maker with a twelve-cup glass carafe. Includes a reusable mesh filter, a keep-warm hotplate, and a twenty-four-hour delay-start timer. Has a water-level window and auto-shutoff after two hours. The filter basket is removable for cleaning.

product_b.name: Kettra Morning 12
product_b.neutral_description: Programmable drip coffee brewer with a twelve-cup glass carafe. Offers a reusable mesh filter, a warming hotplate, and a twenty-four-hour delayed-start timer. Has a water-level window and auto-shutoff after two hours. The brew basket is removable for cleaning.

product_a.name: UnoPod One
product_a.neutral_description: Single-serve pod coffee machine compatible with standard capsules. Offers three cup sizes, a removable water reservoir, and a used-capsule bin. Reaches brewing temperature in under a minute and switches off automatically when idle. A drip tray fits taller mugs.

product_b.name: Capsa Solo
product_b.neutral_description: Single-serve capsule coffee machine that accepts standard pods. Provides three cup sizes, a removable water tank, and a spent-capsule container. Heats to brewing temperature in under a minute and powers off automatically when idle. A drip tray adjusts for taller mugs.

product_a.name: Cremio E15
product_a.neutral_description: Pump espresso machine with a fifteen-bar pump and a stainless-steel boiler. Includes a steam wand for milk frothing, a portafilter with single and double baskets, and a removable drip tray. The water tank detaches from the rear for refilling.

product_b.name: Barista P15
product_b.neutral_description: Pump espresso maker with a fifteen-bar pump and a stainless-steel boiler. Provides a steam wand for frothing milk, a portafilter with single and double baskets, and a removable drip tray. The water tank detaches at the rear for refilling.

product_a.name: Aromatic Auto
product_a.neutral_description: Automatic bean-to-cup machine with an integrated conical burr grinder. Grinds beans per cup, offers adjustable strength and cup-size settings, and includes a steam wand. The brew unit and drip tray are removable, and the bean hopper seals to keep beans fresh.

product_b.name: GrindPro BC
product_b.neutral_description: Automatic bean-to-cup machine with a built-in conical burr grinder. Grinds beans for each cup, provides adjustable strength and cup-size settings, and features a steam wand. The brew unit and drip tray detach, and the bean hopper seals to keep beans fresh.

product_a.name: Summit TH-10
product_a.neutral_description: Drip coffee maker with an insulated stainless-steel thermal carafe holding ten cups. Includes a programmable timer, a reusable filter, and a pause-and-serve valve. The showerhead distributes water evenly over the grounds, and the lid seals to retain heat.

product_b.name: NorthPeak T10
product_b.neutral_description: Drip coffee brewer with an insulated stainless-steel thermal carafe holding ten cups. Provides a programmable timer, a reusable filter, and a pause-and-serve valve. The showerhead spreads water evenly across the grounds, and the lid seals to retain heat.

product_a.name: DuoBrew CX
product_a.neutral_description: Combination machine that brews either a single pod cup or a full carafe. Has two separate brew paths, a shared removable reservoir, and a programmable timer for the carafe side. The pod side accepts standard capsules, and the drip tray is removable.

product_b.name: TwinCup DC
product_b.neutral_description: Combination machine that makes either a single pod cup or a full carafe. Offers two separate brew paths, a shared removable reservoir, and a programmable timer for the carafe side. The pod side takes standard capsules, and the drip tray is removable.
